title: Disk full at 3 AM

alert.title: api-1: disk 97% full
alert.summary: File uploads are failing with errors. The pager went off at 3:04 AM.

clues.title: API error log, last lines
lines: 03:04:11 ERROR upload failed: ENOSPC: no space left on device
03:04:12 ERROR upload failed: ENOSPC: no space left on device

clues.title: Disk used on api-1, last 7 days
lines: Steady growth of about 8% a day since Monday.

actions.label: Restart the API
actions.feedback: The API comes back, but the disk is still 97% full and uploads keep failing.

actions.label: Empty /tmp
actions.feedback: That freed 120 MB. The disk is still 97% full.

actions.label: Delete old files in /srv/uploads
actions.feedback: You freed 4 GB by deleting customers' files. Support tickets start arriving.

actions.label: Compress old logs
actions.feedback: That frees 30 GB and uploads work again, but debug logs still fill the disk 8% a day.

actions.label: Turn debug logging off and compress old logs
actions.feedback: Log volume drops 90% and the disk falls to 35%. Uploads recover.

rootCause.summary: Debug logging was left on after Monday's release, and old logs were kept uncompressed, so the log folder filled the disk.
keyPoints: debug logging was left on after the release
the API logs filled the disk

lesson: Alert on how fast a disk is filling, not only when it is full, and reset log levels after a release.
